messages:
Elise Turner: FYI — OlivePay onboarding showing steady p95 drift on /complete (currently ~2.0s) and token usage ~32% above their forecast. Traffic pattern: lots of short payment validation calls (~20-70 tokens) and occasional day-end batch reconciliations. Proactive plan: (A) divert short validation calls to a compact int4 model, (B) enable short-lived prefix/KV caching for session flows, (C) schedule a small Dedicated hedge during their peak 13:00-17:00 UTC. Thoughts?

Ravi Kulkarni: Agree. We need a tight QA slice focused on numeric precision, currency formats, and idempotency on short inputs. Hana — can you assemble a 20-case harness?

Hana Ito: On it. I'll include edge cases (leading zeros, country codes, odd separators) and run smoke tests on the compact candidate. Proposed selector: token_count <= 90 or header.txn_phase == \"validation\". Fallback to standard-3b for >512 tokens or on regression.

Elise Turner: Draft routing snippet for eng-runtime (handy for ops):
```json
{"route":"/complete","selector":"token_count <= 90 || header.txn_phase==\"validation\"","primary":"olive-compact-1.6b-int4","fallback":"olive-standard-3b","cache":{"prefix_kv":true,"ttl_seconds":180},"dedicated_window":"13:00-17:00 UTC"}
```

Ravi Kulkarni: Good. For renewal narrative, frame as a low-effort cost-latency pilot: 24h canary (3% traffic) then show concrete monthly savings projection. I'll prepare the ROI slide if QA is green.

Hana Ito: Quality gate: <=5% regression on the 20-case set and no critical failures on numeric parsing. If gate fails, automatic rollback to standard-3b.

Elise Turner: @eng-runtime-bot please schedule a 3% traffic canary for 24h starting 2026-11-02T13:00:00Z. Monitor latency_p95, 5xx, token_delta, and regression_rate.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary scheduled: job_id=olivepay-canary-845000-01, start=2026-11-02T13:00:00Z, traffic=3%, duration=24h. Monitoring hooks configured (latency_p95, 5xx, token_delta, regression_rate). Will post results. :gear:

ops-bot: Logged pilot on account timeline and added a renewal note for the CS lead to hold outreach until results.

Ravi Kulkarni: If canary is green, plan a quick enablement call (15 min) with OlivePay PMs to show behavior and fallback semantics. Also include sample failure cases and rollback instructions in the renewal appendix.

Hana Ito: I'll run the harness immediately after canary and post a short pass/fail summary plus up to 3 illustrative failure prompts.

Elise Turner: Great — updating renewal tracker (status: pilot-scheduled). Tagging CS sync next Wednesday to review. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
